justification: Page is titled 'Midea 130L R600A CHEST FREEZER | MD-RC151FZB01' and the asset banner itself prints 'MD-RC151FZB01 CHEST FREEZER 130L SINGLE DOOR', so the model code matches, but display_name names a 99L capacity which both page and image contradict with 130L.

SKL Hardware page title reads "'EAGLE' EG2030 20M WATER HOSE REEL COMPLETE SET", matching display_name; the asset shows the complete hose-reel set (blue drum, metal stand, yellow hose, spray gun) of exactly this type.
